text:
Tyler Benson: quick retargeting snapshot from the first ~36h (audiences = non-activated signups + recently lapsed). dropping numbers + proposed next iteration.

Spend (to date):
- LinkedIn: $1.9k
- Google Search: $1.1k
- Google Display/YouTube: $0.6k

Topline:
- LinkedIn CTR: 0.62% (benchmarks creative), 0.41% ("ship faster" creative)
- Google Search CTR: 3.8% (expected), CPC a bit higher than forecast
- Display CTR: 0.18% (meh)

LP performance (activation landing page variant):
- LP->Console click-through: 14.2%
- LP->Signup: 6.1%
- Signup->api_key_created (24h window): 34% (directionally ok)
- Signup->first_request_success (72h window): too early + noisy, but currently ~18% (we’re seeing attribution gaps here)

Notes / possible issues:
- some clicks landing on the generic docs quickstart instead of the variant LP (looks like 2 ads still have old URL 😬). fixing now.
- UTMs are coming through on the web side, but console event join is missing for a chunk of traffic (likely cookie -> console auth boundary). might be why "first_request_success" looks artificially low.

Proposal (creative iteration):
1) double down on the Benchmarks proof point (CTR winner) but tighten the message to a single promise: "<2 min to first streaming response" + "token-level latency/cost".
2) add a troubleshooting-forward variant for non-activated: "Stuck on API keys / 401s?" -> links to the new troubleshooting section.
3) pause Display unless we see lift by EOD tomorrow; it’s eating spend with low intent.

Tracker link w/ cut by channel/ad set + UTMs: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1rwiGm0k9Qp-RedwoodGrowthSprint (tab: Retargeting_Week1)

Ben/Soojin can you sanity check the new copy angles before I push to the agencies?

Ben Carter: thanks Tyler. CTR lift on benchmarks is nice. agree on pausing Display if it doesn’t move.

re attribution gaps: do we have a guess if it’s “login in another tab / different browser” vs “console doesn’t persist utm props after auth”? want to make sure we’re not optimizing into the void.

Tyler Benson: i think it’s primarily auth boundary. UTMs captured on LP, but when user clicks into Console and creates an account, we’re losing the original campaign params for the post-auth events.

i’ll sync w/ Logan/Jada but for now i’m tagging this as a measurement caveat in the tracker.

Soojin Lee: copy feedback:
- i’m good with “benchmarks” as long as we link to something concrete. we can’t imply “fastest” / “best” without substantiation.
- love the “<2 min to first streaming response” angle but we should phrase as “Get to your first streaming response in minutes” unless we’re confident it’s actually <2 for most.
- troubleshooting-forward variant is great, but let’s keep it dev-first, not “help desk-y”. maybe “Common gotchas: 401s, model not found, streaming disconnects”

can you share the exact headline/body for LI + Search so i can do a quick claims pass?

Tyler Benson: yep. draft v2:

LI Ad (benchmarks v2)
Headline: “Lower latency. Predictable cost.”
Body: “Run open LLMs with Redwood-verified performance profiles. Streaming, batching, and token-level cost visibility out of the box.”
CTA: “Try the quickstart”

LI Ad (activation minutes v2)
Headline: “First streaming response in minutes”
Body: “Copy/paste a single curl. See latency + cost breakdowns in Console. No yak shaving.”
CTA: “Get started”

LI Ad (troubleshooting v2)
Headline: “Stuck on your first call?”
Body: “Common gotchas + fixes: API keys, 401s, model selection, streaming. Get unblocked fast.”
CTA: “See fixes”

Search (exact-ish):
- “llm inference api low latency”
- “openai alternative hosted llama”
- “streaming chat completions api”

Soojin Lee: looks good directionally. tweaks:
- “Redwood-verified performance profiles” ok.
- “No yak shaving” is fine for LI.
- for troubleshooting ad: maybe remove “stuck” and make it proactive: “First call failing? Common fixes” (stuck reads a bit negative).

Ethan Wallace: for substantiation link, use the benchmarks page we updated last month (has methodology + model/hardware table). 

Use: https://redwoodinference.com/benchmarks (and make sure UTMs append after the path).

Ben Carter: +1. also can we add a lightweight “proof chip” on the LP above the fold (e.g., “See benchmark methodology”) so we’re not burying it?

Tessa Morgan: design-wise yes, but keep it small. we don’t want to distract from the quickstart CTA. i can mock a “benchmarks + methodology” link chip today.

Kenji Nakamura: re the troubleshooting-forward variant: we should align the landing section to the same wording (401s/model selection/streaming). otherwise it’ll feel like bait-and-switch.

i can drop suggested bullets for the LP section in the doc if helpful.

Tyler Benson: perfect. action items:
- i’ll update LI creatives w/ Soojin’s tweaks + add Ethan’s benchmark URL
- i’ll fix the 2 ads with old LP URL + confirm UTMs
- Tessa to mock the “methodology chip” for LP
- Kenji to add troubleshooting bullets aligned to ad copy

will post an updated snapshot tomorrow EOD with: CTR by creative + LP->signup + early key-created.

(reaction) Ben Carter: :thumbsup:
(reaction) Soojin Lee: :white_check_mark:
(reaction) Ethan Wallace: :thumbsup:
(reaction) Tessa Morgan: :+1:
